definitions.explanation: A plant-based milk made from soybeans, widely consumed in Japan both as a beverage and as an ingredient in cooking. A key component in making tofu.

examples.japanese: {毎朝|まいあさ}{豆乳|とうにゅう}を{飲|の}んでいる。
examples.english: I drink soy milk every morning.

examples.japanese: {豆乳|とうにゅう}{鍋|なべ}は{体|からだ}が{温|あたた}まる。
examples.english: Soy milk hot pot warms you up.

examples.japanese: {牛乳|ぎゅうにゅう}の{代|か}わりに{豆乳|とうにゅう}を{使|つか}ってスープを{作|つく}った。
examples.english: I made soup using soy milk instead of cow's milk.

notes:
USAGE:
{豆乳|とうにゅう} is a staple in Japanese cuisine and health food culture. Japan has a wide variety of flavored soy milk drinks available at convenience stores. In cooking, soy milk is the base ingredient for making {豆腐|とうふ} (tofu) and is also used in hot pot dishes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}{鍋|なべ}: soy milk hot pot
- {調整|ちょうせい}{豆乳|とうにゅう}: adjusted soy milk (sweetened/flavored)
- {無調整|むちょうせい}{豆乳|とうにゅう}: unadjusted/plain soy milk
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}ラテ: soy milk latte
- {豆乳|とうにゅう}プリン: soy milk pudding
